Taxonomy.description: A flat vocabulary of terms, stored as WordPress taxonomy terms rather than a table of the framework's own. A many-to-many edge into an entity using this pattern lives in wp_term_relationships, so the same vocabulary can classify posts of different types without being declared once per type, and a term applies or lifts without moving any row the term itself did not own.

taxonomy.description: Marks this entity's rows as WordPress taxonomy terms.

name.description: The term's label. A taxonomy-backed entity has exactly this field — anything else declared here has nowhere to live in wp_term_taxonomy and is silently dropped at runtime.
